header: The v1 golden fixture (docs/specs/s5.md section 6.6, S5-01): one sha256 per v1 surface, taken at 9aa27de (wave-3's close). It is NEVER regenerated in an S5 PR: a changed hash means v1 moved, and that blocks the merge with no exception (section 9.4, stop rule 3). Fix the code that moved, not the hash. `bun scripts/v1-golden.ts --check` and tests/fleet/v1-golden.test.ts recompute every surface; `--write` only creates a missing file.

graded-seeds.covers: drawGradedSeeds on 20 entropies (0x3a12-0x3a25): the seeds, the band outcome and the draw count

act1.covers: runAct1 with no modules on the practice scenario and on 20 graded seeds: the whole ActResult (metrics, values, verdict)

act2.covers: runAct2 for every worker count x router on the practice scenario and on 20 graded seeds: the whole ActResult

act3.covers: evalAct3 on the practice scenario and on 20 graded seeds: every hardware option priced, the best value, the receipt values

fleet-ex:knee.covers: the knee exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene

fleet-ex:pd-split.covers: the pd-split exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene

fleet-ex:broken-bench.covers: the broken-bench exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene

fleet-ex:push-luck.covers: the push-luck exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene

fleet-ex:straggler.covers: the straggler exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene

fleet-ex:timing-oracle.covers: the timing-oracle exercise on seeds 0-19: sweep, truth, band, scene and ask

leaderboard-reference.covers: scoreReferenceBenchmark on the committed BurstGPT and LMSYS-shape traces, and the Fleet leg (runFleetBenchmark) it scores: ticks, stats, goodput

leaderboard-lab.covers: runCanonicalLabHarness with the JS reference scheduler (the lab leg without the Rust lab): checks, the seven scenarios, scores

daily.covers: the 30 Daily dates from DAILY_EPOCH: the incident, the expert run (burn, probes, steps), two scripted plays' outcomes, the share strings

sig.covers: the sig family on the seeds of its own hash fixture (verify-generators' HASH_SEEDS from base 0x68617368), every variant at every level: params, prompt (the telemetry tables) and answer

scheduler-play.covers: the scheduler play's practice minute (seed 150): the trace, the five band rules with the ghost, FCFS and greedy runs, and the reference played to the debrief

primm.covers: PRIMM's reference run, runTrace(REFERENCE) (recomputed: REFERENCE_RUN is not exported), and the run of every order x headroom x report on its seed
